claims.claim: stage.ImagePreprocessConfig{Resize: stage.ImageResizeStageConfig{MaxWidth, MaxHeight, MaxSizeBytes, Quality, PreserveAspectRatio, SkipIfSmaller}, EnableResize}
Option defaults: MaxWidth 1024, MaxHeight 1024, MaxSizeBytes 0 no limit, Quality 85, PreserveAspectRatio true, SkipIfSmaller true, EnableResize true

If dimensions exceed limits the image is resized; aspect ratio preserved if configured; re-encoded with quality; over MaxSizeBytes quality reduced iteratively; processed image replaces original in message
Input formats JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; output formats JPEG (default), PNG
Mobile example: config literal with MaxWidth 512, MaxHeight 512, MaxSizeBytes 100KB, Quality 70, EnableResize true behaves as aggressive compression
Preprocessing runs as a pipeline stage StateStoreLoad -> PromptAssembly -> Template -> ContextBuilder -> ImagePreprocess -> Provider -> StateStoreSave
sdk.WithImageFile(path) sends an image that is auto resized; example compiles
